name: Session Tracker
description: Tracks play sessions, time and attempts per level, with copies merged into one

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub or in the Discord server

count-practice.name: Count practice attempts
count-practice.description: Add practice mode attempts to the attempt totals. They are always saved separately either way.

auto-merge-copies.name: Merge copies automatically
auto-merge-copies.description: Put a copied level in the same group as its original, so their stats add up. Levels you merged or split by hand are never changed.

min-session-seconds.name: Minimum session length
min-session-seconds.description: Sessions shorter than this many seconds of play are not saved.
